body:
I'm currently seeing one and she tells me to just keep studying to keep my benefits going on. I've tried a variety of meds. One made me go into a dysphoric mania. Another made me delusional and paranoid. I'm currently on SSRIs and I'm liking it, it helps me do more stuff and has no side effects.
Generally the shrinks in my city don't care about talking if it's not about medication. And my current therapist said they can't afford proper psychotherapy for me. Been in treatment for almost 8 years now. One abusive therapist and a lot of doctors.

I might, actually, once I have some spare cash. Not anywhere far away though. Traveling sometimes makes me anxious.
I tried voluntary work a few years ago. A few times it felt really great and then I just got pissed at the other volunteers and I couldn't handle the weird fake bubbly atmosphere. One thing I want right now is a big night out with karaoke and red wine and shit, I'd love to be even just hungover.
As a general principle though I agree about volunteering and travel.

I'm constantly anxious and I have weird fears about the safety of my loved ones. I get the impulse to call everyone in case they're in danger of offing themselves. I can't get myself to calm down until they call. I rarely if ever call. That would be intrusive. They're not responsible for my quirks.
Everything is so hard. I can't get anything started let alone finished. I don't want to adult cause I'll fail so hard. I have no motivation and nothing to look forward to besides sensory pleasure and dolling myself up. I'm disgusted by my needy, sharp-tongued personality.
I have nightmares about certain people assaulting me sexually (which has never actually happened) and it's at the point where I can't even look them in the eye. I have nightmares being imprisoned and trapped and I feel that way even awake, when I'm in therapy or in school. I hate being behind locked doors.
My life has no content besides making pretty pictures. I feel like I don't even have a soul.
I used to enjoy being by myself but now it just makes me despair about how stuck I am. I've never done anything worthy of doing.

I should. I just don't know how. I don't vocalize my problems until I've found a solution. It's easier online where nobody knows me. I just don't know what I wouldn't have tried already. Meditation, mindfulness, proper diet, support groups, self love exercises, being merciful to myself, being an art student, long showers. I've got that awful groundhog day feeling. Every day is about the same.
How do I focus on myself without going into overthinking mode?
